basis_reason: the reported comparison figure is Net of Fees and Before-Tax (twr_fee_method, twr_tax_method in ~49's record); the net basis leaves the advisory fee inside the return, so it is the like-for-like basis and the one ~49's flow_set_probe uses. The gross basis (fee added back) is recorded beside it.
computable_note: 79 windows have a broken geometric link (no prior-day base) under every flow set and can never be within; the same 483 are computable in every row below
ratified_flow_set: contributions and distributions only (the ratified NNA set: ext); Internal Account Journal In/Out stay Internal and Federal/State Tax Withheld stay Return, so both are inside the value
proposed_flow_set: ratified NNA flows plus Internal Account Journal In/Out plus Federal/State Tax Withheld as account-boundary flows

gross_basis.reading: the gross basis adds the advisory fee back, so it is not like-for-like against a Net of Fees figure; its within count is 24 under the proposed set and 43 under the ratified one. It is recorded, not preferred (row IRPT_DASHBD-W54-S2).

claim_note: within counts are measured on one sample at one snapshot; that a flow set fits better is a fit, not a vendor rule (annualisation_basis held in orion_sources.json)
